human_name: NPHP1 (nephrocystin-1) tandem locus at 2q13 with flanking 45 kb directly-oriented LCRs

GRCh38.note: NPHP1 gene proper (Ensembl GRCh38). The pathogenic ~290 kb recurrent deletion spans NPHP1 plus the ~45 kb flanking LCRs from approx chr2:110,030,000-110,330,000; the locus sits in a complex inverted-repeat / direct-repeat architecture at 2q13

copy_count_typical: 2-3 directly-oriented 45 kb LCR copies flanking NPHP1; flanking ~330 kb inverted repeats add a second layer
architecture_note: Lupski-style classical recurrent-DEL architecture. Two directly-oriented ~45 kb LCRs flank NPHP1; NAHR between them produces a recurrent ~290 kb homozygous deletion that accounts for ~80% of NPHP1 disease cases (Saunier 2000). Additionally, two larger ~330 kb inverted repeats flank the whole locus and can produce non-pathogenic inversion polymorphisms.

diagnostic_features.psv_strategy_note: Per-base PSV tables for the NPHP1 flanking 45 kb LCRs are not standardised in the literature; the locus is classically diagnosed at the structural (CNV / deletion) level, not at SNP level. Diagnostic discrimination relies on (a) detecting copy-number of NPHP1 itself (0 = pathogenic homozygous deletion, 1 = heterozygous carrier, 2 = wild-type), (b) breakpoint signature in the flanking 45 kb LCR pair, (c) presence/absence of MALL gene which is co-deleted in the ~290 kb pathogenic allele. For LLmap T1 the discriminator is read-depth + flanking junction sequence, not a discrete SNP set.

recurrent_deletion.mechanism: NAHR between two directly-oriented ~45 kb LCRs
recurrent_deletion.note: Saunier et al. 2000 AJHG 66:778-789 — original characterization.

inversion_polymorphism.note: Yu et al. 2015 PLOS Genet — characterised the inversion polymorphism flanked by two inverted ~358 kb LCRs.

primary.note: k=25 / mm=2 for the NPHP1 gene body itself (single-copy in the wild-type allele). Mapping must additionally check the flanking 45 kb LCR boundary signature to call deletion vs canonical.

fallback_chain.name: relaxed_mismatch
fallback_chain.rationale: flanking LCR has 99.5% identity — variants within an LCR copy can still chain-fail at mm=2

fallback_chain.name: depth_check
fallback_chain.rationale: depth at NPHP1 vs flanking unique = best deletion-call signal; primary structural diagnostic

fallback_chain.name: junction_search
fallback_chain.rationale: find LCR-A / LCR-B junction read evidence to confirm the recurrent 290 kb breakpoint

fallback_chain.name: llm_checkpoint
fallback_chain.trigger: atypical junction not matching the canonical ~290 kb pattern
fallback_chain.rationale: rare non-recurrent breakpoints reported (Saunier 2000); LLM evaluation of novel breakpoint sequence

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: report 'NPHP1 locus structural variant — non-canonical breakpoint' for curator review

test_cases.note: GIAB HG002 has wild-type NPHP1 — useful as negative control for deletion detection
Synthetic placeholder for any NPHP1-deleted patient case — expect 0x depth over NPHP1 + canonical ~290 kb breakpoint junction (Saunier 2000)

primary_sources.note: Saunier S, Calado J, Benessy F et al. — Characterization of the NPHP1 locus: mutational mechanism involved in deletions in familial juvenile nephronophthisis. Am J Hum Genet 66:778-789. Note: original Saunier et al. 1997 (Nat Genet) reported the linkage; the 2000 AJHG paper is the segmental-architecture characterization paper and is the appropriate primary citation for SD architecture.

Yu H, Liu G, Liu Y et al. — Comparative genomic analyses of the human NPHP1 locus reveal complex genomic architecture and its regional evolution in primates. PLOS Genet 11:e1005686. Detailed comparative SD analysis.
Nephronophthisis-1 (juvenile) — OMIM clinical reference; lists the locus and recurrent-deletion phenotype.

supporting_databases: UCSC genomicSuperDups (hg38) — captures the flanking 45 kb LCRs and the larger 330 kb inverted repeats
ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map ISCA-37405 (NPHP1 region)
T2T-CHM13 v2.0 — NPHP1 locus resolved (no SD-collapse)
HPRC R2 pangenome — haplotype-level inversion polymorphism evidence
provenance.db_coverage_note: Locus is well represented in UCSC SD and ClinGen. GRCh38 has both flanking 45 kb LCRs correctly placed (unlike IGHG4 dup); structural detection is feasible from short-read depth + long-read junction.
